info.title: AFAS Organisaties en personen API
info.description: This API describes the endpoints related to Organisaties en personen. Use this API with the functional description of the API.

get.summary: Retrieve the meta info of the Profit environment and the available connectors
Retrieve the metainfo of a specific connector based on the endpoint id. This includes the fields and their properties.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Add the type of connector you want to get the meta info from

parameters.name: Endpoint
parameters.description: Add the endpoint id of the connector you want to get the meta info from

get.summary: Retrieve the metainfo of a custom getconnector based on the endpoint id. This includes the fields and their properties. These id's can be found in the metainfo request result.

parameters.name: Endpoint
parameters.description: Add the id of connector you want to get the meta info from

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Pagination: amount of results skipped. Starts at 0

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Pagination: amount of results returned

parameters.name: orderbyfieldids
parameters.description: Must be used to prevent unexpectedly ordered results

parameters.name: filterfieldids
parameters.description: The fieldIds of the values to filter on

parameters.name: filtervalues
parameters.description: The values to filter on

parameters.name: operatortypes
parameters.description:
Operator for comparing filter values. Supported values include:

* `1` - =  (is equal to)
* `2` - >= (is greater or equal to)
* `3` - <= (is less or equal to)
* `4` - >  (is greater than)
* `5` - <  (is less than)
* `6` - *  (contains text)
* `7` - != (is not equal to)
* `8` - [] (is empty)
* `9` - ![] (is not empty)
* `10` - @   (starts with)
* `11` - !* (does not contain text)
* `12` - !@ (does not start with)
* `13` - &  (ends with)
* `14` - !& (does not end with)
* `15` - Sf (quickfilter)

Fields.Body: Join us for the inaugural Galactic Innovators Council to discuss cutting-edge space technologies and collaboration opportunities on interstellar projects.

Fields.Sbj: Spacelab meeting with DavidB and demo
Invitation to attend the 2nd Galactic Convention on Interstellar Travel
Fields.Body: We are pleased to invite you to the 2nd Galactic Convention on Interstellar Travel, an incredible opportunity to explore the latest breakthroughs and advancements in the field of interstellar travel. The event will be held on October 20th, 2525 at the majestic Aurora Expo-Center, Mars.
Updated agenda and details for the upcoming interstellar summit featuring renowned speakers and exciting demonstrations on futuristic space technologies.

parameters.description:
Operator for comparing filter values. Supported values include:

* `1` - =  (is equal to)
* `2` - >= (is greater or equal to)
* `3` - <= (is less or equal to)
* `4` - >  (is greater than)
* `5` - <  (is less than)
* `6` - *  (contains text)
* `7` - != (is not equal to)
* `8` - [] (is empty)
* `9` - ![] (is not empty)
* `10` - @   (starts with)
* `11` - !* (does not contain text)
* `12` - !@ (does not start with)
* `13` - &  (ends with)
* `14` - !& (does not end with)
* `15` - Sf (quickfilter)
